content.json:
## GitHub Advanced Security alerts

Active GHAS alerts, grouped by the latest event for each repository, alert, and branch.

content.query:
GHASAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RepositoryUrl, AlertId, GitRef
| where State =~ 'active'
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, AlertType, Title, ProjectName, RepositoryName, GitRef, AlertUrl
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Active GHAS alerts

content.query:
GHASAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RepositoryUrl, AlertId, GitRef
| where State =~ 'active'
| summarize AlertCount = count() by Severity
| order by AlertCount desc
content.title: Active alerts by severity

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Message has 'Ingested GHAS event' or SeverityLevel >= 3
| project TimeGenerated, SeverityLevel, Message, OperationName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Function processing and errors (24h)

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| project TimeGenerated, ExceptionType, ProblemId, OuterMessage, OperationName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Function exceptions (24h)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResourceProvider =~ 'MICROSOFT.SERVICEBUS'
| summarize Events = count() by Category, OperationName
| order by Events desc
content.title: Service Bus operations (24h)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResourceProvider =~ 'MICROSOFT.SERVICEBUS'
| where MetricName has 'DeadletteredMessages'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Total) by Resource, MetricName
| project TimeGenerated, Resource, MetricName, Total
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Service Bus dead-letter metrics (24h)
